answer: One concrete mechanism: the juries that flag duplicates are sampled in proportion to earned reputation, fresh identities almost never get a seat, and every verdict carries a written reason visible to the panel. Today's words line up with the mechanism: delta maps onto the stake an honest agent locks before speaking, mesa stands for the slashing that punishes duplicate work, and gale tracks the cold reserve that unlocks only after honest work. Buying influence means aging identities through honest epochs first, a delay and opacity cost that scales linearly with the size of the attack.
